subject.title: Feature: Activity-based heartbeat with idle timeout

question: What canonical heartbeat activity gate should OpenClaw support for scheduled heartbeat runs?
rationale: This adds public heartbeat configuration and changes when background agent turns consume model tokens, so automation should not choose the idle key name, activity source, default window, or wake exceptions without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve core idle gate
options.body: Define one heartbeat idle-timeout key and activity source, then implement schema, docs, config inventory, runtime gating, and regression tests for scheduled runs.

options.title: Limit to narrower safety fixes
options.body: Keep this issue open while only landing missing-file, zombie-session, retry, or cost-circuit-breaker fixes until broader idle semantics are decided.

options.title: Reject new heartbeat config
options.body: Close or narrow this direction if maintainers decide activeHours, isolatedSession, lightContext, and targeted safety fixes are the supported cost controls.

recommendation.title: Approve core idle gate
recommendation.body: Define one heartbeat idle-timeout key and activity source, then implement schema, docs, config inventory, runtime gating, and regression tests for scheduled runs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already reviewed this item as the canonical tracker and has recent heartbeat docs/runtime history, making him the best available owner for the product-shape choice.
